verdict_short: Test 32B CPU feasibility as highest-value next experiment

context_summary.phase14: Validated packed INT8 sidecars on Qwen2.5 0.5B/3B/7B
context_summary.phase15: Validated and optimized packed INT6 on Qwen2.5-7B
context_summary.phase16: Validated packed INT6 on Qwen2.5-14B Q4_K_M through 16C-N

proven_claims: Packed INT8 and INT6 sidecar paths preserved tested behavior on Qwen2.5 models in Matt's measured CPU setup
Qwen2.5-14B Q4_K_M INT6 PRT passed: tiny canary, 8-prompt suite, n=320 longer prose, c=2048 larger context
Generation throughput was ~0.977-1.009x native in tested prompt suite
Memory remained stable at ~12GB available throughout 14B validation
Sidecar loader has hardcoded size checks for 7B and 14B only
INT6 remains experimental; INT8 remains the validated runtime path
unproven_claims: No production readiness (no hardening, error handling, edge-case coverage)
No universal speedup (single CPU setup, limited prompt suite)
No broad long-context guarantee (only tested to c=2048)
No automatic model detection (hardcoded size checks in loader)
No larger-model sidecar generation feasibility at 30B+

options_ranked.rationale: Tests whether CPU-only boundary extends beyond 14B. Directly serves Matt's mini-goal of expanding what runs on CPU-only hardware.
Unlocks automatic model detection and kernel-level speedups. Important infrastructure but doesn't directly expand demonstrated CPU boundary.

options_ranked.next_step_value: Medium for credibility, low for expanding capability
options_ranked.rationale: Strengthens evidence base but doesn't reveal anything new about approach limits. Valuable for credibility, not as next move.
Can happen in parallel. Posting now is acceptable with explicit caveat about one-run limitation. Waiting for repeatability is also valid.
CLI-level optimization largely exhausted after Phase 15H. Wall/setup overhead is memory-bandwidth-bound; only kernel changes can address it.

recommended_next_phase.name: Phase 17B: 32B CPU Feasibility Canary
recommended_next_phase.reason: Highest-value experiment for Matt's stated CPU-inference goal. Tests whether boundary extends beyond 14B.
plan: Check disk (~20GB available) and download Qwen2.5-32B Q4_K_M GGUF from HuggingFace
Run native tiny canary (ctx=256, n=32) to confirm model loads without OOM
If OOM: document as exceeding machine capacity, pivot to 8B as backup
If stable: run native tiny generation to confirm output behavior
Check FFN_UP tensor shape via gguf API for loader update
Update loader for 32B (add to known-size list, same pattern as Phase 16J)
Generate 32B INT6 sidecar canary (2-4 layers) to validate format for 32B
If canary passes: generate full 64-layer INT6 sidecar set (~14min expected)
Run 32B PRT tiny canary to confirm sidecar layers load correctly
Document 32B boundary result whether it fits or fails
recommended_next_phase.pass_criteria: 32B Q4_K_M loads in native mode at ctx=256, generates without OOM, memory footprint understood, sidecar canary produces correct matvec output
recommended_next_phase.conditional_pass: 32B loads but OOMs at context >512. Document context limit. Still meaningful result.
recommended_next_phase.fail_criteria: 32B OOMs at load or first token at minimal context. Document as exceeding machine. Recommend 8B alternative.
recommended_next_phase.backup: Phase 17C: 8B validation (Qwen2.5-8B or Llama-3.1-8B — ~4-5GB, well within 15GB RAM)

what_not_to_do: Do not attempt 70B or larger (exceeds RAM and disk for this project)
Do not spend more time on CLI-level INT6 optimization (exhausted after Phase 15H)
Do not post public claims without repeatability (critics will ask 'run it again')
Do not force 32B if it OOMs (pivot to 8B, don't force)
Do not touch existing frozen tags (Phase 16M is locked)
final_recommendation: Given the current evidence, I recommend going to 32B next because the highest-value experiment for your stated goal — proving CPU inference works on hardware people assume is impractical — is to test whether the boundary extends beyond 14B. Run the feasibility canary first (native load at small context), and if it doesn't fit, pivot to 8B as the backup.
